---
name: New a11y area / preset request
about: Suggest a new preference category or preset (e.g. a new color-vision preset, a new preference PrefKeeper doesn't cover yet)
labels: a11y-area
---

**What's the accessibility need?**
Describe the real-world situation this would help with.

**What would it look like in PrefKeeper?**
E.g. "a new preset on the Colors tab for X," or "a new tab/category for Y."

**Is this something a custom preset could already handle?**
PrefKeeper supports developer-supplied custom presets today (see the
README) without needing a core code change. If your idea can be a
preset rather than a new built-in feature, that's often the faster
path — mention if you've already tried that route.
